doc_title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Earnings Forecast, Dividend of Surplus (Dividend Increase), and Revision of Year-End Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
doc_title_jp: 業績予想の修正、剰余金の配当（増配）および期末配当予想の修正（増配）に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 貸出金利息と非金利業務利益の増加により、本業のコア業務純益が順調に推移

summary_en: The Gunma Bank raised its FY2027 dividend forecast to ¥74.00 per share (from ¥70.00), comprising an interim dividend of ¥37.00 (increased from ¥35.00) paid on November 30, 2026, and a revised year-end dividend forecast of ¥37.00 (increased from ¥35.00). The interim dividend is based on improved core business performance including higher lending interest and non-interest income.
summary_jp: 2027年3月期の年間配当予想を70円から74円に修正。中間配当は35円から37円に引き上げ、11月30日に支払う。期末配当予想も35円から37円に修正。貸出金利息と非金利業務利益の増加で本業が好調なため。
